screen.selarium.codex.start.title: Getting Started
screen.selarium.codex.start.p1: Find Arcane Geodes underground. Mature clusters yield crystals; the Arcane Grinder turns crystals into Arcane Dust.
screen.selarium.codex.start.p2: Arcane Trees can mark a geode: follow the pale stone vein below the trunk. Arcane Petals offer a little dust near the surface.
screen.selarium.codex.start.p3: Use Arcane Dust on a sturdy block to create a sigil. Add specialized dusts to compose wards.
screen.selarium.codex.start.p4: All 32 wards remain available through sigils. The Inscription Bench adds scrolls and progression.
screen.selarium.codex.mana.title: Mana
screen.selarium.codex.mana.p1: Active wards pay upkeep in cycles. Payment uses the sigil reserve, adjacent tanks, then the owner's mana where allowed.
screen.selarium.codex.mana.p2: Your starting limit is 500. Successive rituals unlock 1,000, 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000; each tier requires milestones and mana.
screen.selarium.codex.mana.p3: Mana spent, discovered wards and unlocked tiers persist through death, dimension changes and restarts.
screen.selarium.codex.grinder.title: Arcane Grinder
screen.selarium.codex.grinder.p1: The Arcane Grinder turns crystals into Arcane Dust and combines dusts with reagents to make specialized variants.
screen.selarium.codex.grinder.p2: Refined wards require refined dust for every specialized component. Arcane Dust remains basic.
screen.selarium.codex.recipes.title: Core Recipes
screen.selarium.codex.recipes.p1: Paper, string and Arcane Dust make an Empty Scroll. Use it in the Inscription Bench with dusts and catalysts.
screen.selarium.codex.recipes.p2: Nine crystals make an Arcane Block. Arcane Crystal catalyzes basic wards; Arcane Block catalyzes refined wards.
screen.selarium.codex.recipes.p3: A book and Arcane Dust make the Codex. The Grimoire also needs Binding and Focus Dust.
screen.selarium.codex.dusts.title: Dusts
screen.selarium.codex.dusts.p1: Arcane is the base. Aegis protects; Vital sustains; Focus directs; Binding holds; Echo senses; Density anchors; Warp displaces; Veil conceals; Chrono bends timing.
screen.selarium.codex.dusts.p2: Basic recipes accept basic or refined dust. Refined recipes accept only refined specialized components.
screen.selarium.codex.sigils.title: Sigils
screen.selarium.codex.sigils.p1: Look at your sigil, sneak and scroll to preview compatible wards drawn on it. Right click without dust to bind the preview.
screen.selarium.codex.sigils.p2: Sneak + right click without a pending preview toggles the field. Normal right click opens the details and returns removed dust to inventory or ground.
screen.selarium.codex.sigils.p3: A sigil belongs to its creator. A ward must be activated on a sigil before its scroll can be inscribed.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.title: Progression
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p1: 1,000: spend 250 mana and activate 3 distinct wards. Inscribe basic Focus, Vital and Aegis with an Arcane Crystal. Ritual: 250 mana.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p2: 2,500: spend 1,200 mana and activate 6 wards, 2 refined. Inscribe refined Focus, Vital and Binding with a Blaze Rod and Arcane Block. Ritual: 700 mana.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p3: 5,000: spend 4,000 mana and activate 10 wards, 4 refined. Inscribe refined Warp, Veil and Focus with Dragon's Breath and an Ender Pearl. Ritual: 1,800 mana.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p4: 10,000: spend 10,000 mana and activate 16 wards, 8 refined. Inscribe refined Aegis, Echo and Chrono with a Nether Star and Echo Shard. Ritual: 4,000 mana.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p5: Use an Attunement Scroll on your own inactive sigil. The ritual validates milestones again before charging mana.
screen.selarium.codex.progression.p6: The ritual can use the sigil reserve, adjacent tanks and owner mana, in that order. Failures preserve the scroll and mana.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.title: Scrolls
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p1: The Inscription Bench has an Empty Scroll slot, five dust slots, two catalyst slots and an output. Choose a recipe in its list.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p2: A Ward Scroll requires a ward already activated by its creator. Inscribe its dusts with Arcane Crystal or Arcane Block.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p3: Every scroll stores its creator's UUID. Only that player may use it. A valid cast consumes one scroll and the first mana charge.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p4: Mobile fields follow their creator; the others appear where pointed. Limits: two mobile, three fixed and no duplicate ward.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p5: The field lasts half a sigil's duration, pays the same upkeep and follows Grimoire rules. Its cooldown starts when it ends.
screen.selarium.codex.scrolls.p6: Mobile fields pause while offline, follow dimension changes and end on death. Fixed fields persist in the world until expiry.
screen.selarium.codex.grimoire.title: Grimoire
screen.selarium.codex.grimoire.p1: The Codex teaches; the Grimoire defines targets. Configure allies, enemies and entity categories before starting a field.
screen.selarium.codex.grimoire.p2: The Grimoire binds to an owner on first use and shares rules across their sigils and scrolls.
screen.selarium.codex.grimoire.p3: Shift + click creatures to record soul knowledge. Activating a ward records its pattern permanently.
screen.selarium.codex.grimoire.p4: Server safety settings, owner protection and allow/deny lists take priority over general rules.
screen.selarium.codex.wards.title: Wards
screen.selarium.codex.wards.p1: A ward is a continuous field. Each cycle pays upkeep and affects valid targets within range, subject to safety limits.
screen.selarium.codex.wards.p2: Open the Ward Atlas on the next page to browse every recipe with its range, upkeep and interval. Missing dust, mana, permission or cooldown prevents activation.
screen.selarium.codex.tanks.title: Mana Tanks
screen.selarium.codex.tanks.p1: Adjacent tanks sustain sigils and rituals after the sigil reserve. Mana fill is visible on all four sides.
screen.selarium.codex.tanks.p2: Scroll fields also use nearby mana sources and their creator's mana for upkeep.
screen.selarium.codex.geodes.title: Geodes
screen.selarium.codex.geodes.p1: Arcane Geodes contain stone, crystal blocks, budding blocks and four crystal growth stages.
screen.selarium.codex.geodes.p2: Mature clusters yield crystals when harvested; Silk Touch preserves the block. Fortune can increase crystals.
screen.selarium.codex.geodes.p3: Arcane Saplings grow ordinary trees. Player grown trees do not create new geodes.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.ambient_: Generates mana with a cap per activation.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.banishme: Moves intruders away from the field.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.citadel: Raises a temporary wall allies can pass through.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.cloaking: Conceals the owner and clears hostile targets.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.efficien: Speeds furnaces and the Arcane Grinder.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.aqualung: Restores air and aids underwater movement.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.transmut: Converts specific items and oxidizes copper.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.tangible: Forms a temporary barrier allies can cross.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.bounty: May add one item to eligible drops.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.immortal: Prevents one allied death per 1,200 ticks for 200 extra mana.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.drain: Drains intruders with capped mana generation each cycle.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.soul_cha: Shares part of the damage among intruders.
screen.selarium.codex.ward_note.phasing: Allows passage through Selarium phasing blocks.
